inventor_provenance.rule: the PR93 and PR94 dirty worktrees are local work performed in the interrupted coding session that hit its session limit; remote and GitHub UI-agent work advanced separately
inventor_provenance.consequence: a superseded pull-request delivery path does not make the interrupted local delta obsolete or disposable; reconcile it file by file against later remote work
inventor_provenance.authority: direct user correction in the resumed 2026-08-31 session

preservation_method.operation: git stash create without updating refs or either dirty worktree, followed by additive publication of the returned commit
preservation_method.snapshot_semantics: first parent is the interrupted worktree HEAD, second parent is the staged index tree, and the preservation commit tree is the complete working-tree snapshot

prior_archive.rule: the archive is preservation evidence and candidate reconciliation input, not current implementation authority

recovery.complete_working_tree: create an isolated worktree at the snapshot commit or inspect snapshot_commit^{tree}
recovery.original_staged_delta: diff the interrupted HEAD against index_parent
recovery.original_final_delta: diff the interrupted HEAD against snapshot_commit
recovery.rule: restore or reconcile only in a new isolated worktree; do not reset, clean, checkout over, or rebase either original dirty worktree

nonclaims: the snapshots are not tested or merge-ready
remote publication is preservation and not acceptance
PR93 or PR94 supersession does not adjudicate the value of any local hunk
the archived refs are not product authority
